previous_statement: Choose e_nat:=e_cmp. Under the hypotheses of node 1, specialize the equality in node 1.1 to the pair (P,Q)=(Q,Q), obtaining Co_{I_n tensor Q,I_n tensor Q}=1_{M_n} tensor Co_{Q,Q}=1_{M_n} tensor Co_Q as linear maps on M_n(A), where Co_{Q,Q}=Co_Q is the abbreviation fixed by def-compressed-corner.
new_statement: Let e_cmp>0 be the universal constant supplied by lem-compcb-amplified-compression and set e_nat:=e_cmp. If e=delta+epsilon <= e_nat, Q is a delta-projection in an extended epsilon-C*-algebra A, and n>=1, then specializing that external result to the pair (P,Q)=(Q,Q) gives Co_{I_n tensor Q,I_n tensor Q}=1_{M_n} tensor Co_{Q,Q}=1_{M_n} tensor Co_Q as linear maps on M_n(A); the last equality is exactly the abbreviation Co_{Q,Q}=Co_Q in def-compressed-corner.
